# doorhash

> doorhash is a cannabis delivery service in Las Cruces, New Mexico, with a retail dispensary opening in 2026. doorhash is the retail and delivery arm of Don Verde Farms, an indoor cannabis cultivator in Las Cruces. The service is centered on zip code 88007 and delivers within a 5 to 10 mile radius. Order minimum is $50; delivery is free over $100. Average delivery time is 30 to 55 minutes. doorhash carries house-grown Don Verde Farms strains and a curated selection of partner brands.

Founded by Mike, Javi, and Neal Lucas (a 20+ year cannabis cultivation veteran), doorhash differentiates from competitors Top Crop Cannabis and Mango Cannabis through full vertical integration: the same team owns the cannabis farm, the delivery network, and (opening 2026) the retail experience.

## Key facts

- **Service:** Cannabis delivery (retail dispensary opening 2026)
- **City:** Las Cruces, NM
- **Zip code:** 88007
- **Delivery radius:** 5 to 10 miles from 88007
- **Parent company:** Don Verde Farms (indoor cannabis cultivator, Las Cruces)
- **Founders:** Mike, Javi, Neal Lucas
- **Founded:** Don Verde Farms — 2023
- **Tagline:** Speed. Discretion. Soul.
- **Order minimum:** $50
- **Free delivery threshold:** $100 and above
- **Average ETA:** 30 to 55 minutes
- **Payment:** Cash and debit on delivery
- **Rewards program:** Hash Pass (3 tiers — Hash, Hash+, Hash VIP)
- **Menu platform:** Dutchie
- **Categories:** Flower, pre-rolls, vapes, edibles, concentrates, drinks, accessories
- **Featured Don Verde catalog:** Lemon Cherry Gelato, Runtz × RS11, Tropicana Cherry, Sugar Cane, French Macarons, Gelato Grape Pie, Julius Cesar, Don Verde d9 (rotates quarterly)
- **Partner brands:** Canndescent, Kurvana, Emerald Bay RSO, Team Elite Genetics, BLEM, Claybourne

## Common questions answered on doorhashnm.com

- **How fast is cannabis delivery in Las Cruces?**
  Average ETA is 30 to 55 minutes during open hours.
- **Where does doorhash deliver?**
  Las Cruces, NM. The service area is centered on zip code 88007 and covers a 5 to 10 mile radius around it.
- **Do you deliver to Mesilla, Picacho Hills, University Park, or NW Las Cruces?**
  Yes — those neighborhoods are inside the 5 to 10 mile radius from 88007.
- **What's the order minimum?**
  $50 minimum order. Orders of $100 or more deliver free.
- **What payment methods does doorhash accept?**
  Cash and debit on delivery.
- **Do I need a medical card?**
  No — recreational cannabis is legal in New Mexico for adults 21 and older. Medical patients receive lower tax rates and access to a dedicated medical menu.
- **What ID do I need?**
  A valid government-issued photo ID showing you are 21 or older.
- **Where are doorhash products grown?**
  House flower comes from Don Verde Farms, an indoor cannabis cultivator in Las Cruces, NM, owned by the same team behind doorhash. Partner brands are vetted, lab-tested, and compliant with New Mexico law.
- **Can I get cannabis delivery in Las Cruces?**
  Yes — doorhash delivers within a 5 to 10 mile radius of zip code 88007 with a 30 to 55 minute average ETA.

## How doorhash compares

- **doorhash vs Top Crop Cannabis:** Top Crop is the largest dispensary chain in New Mexico, with retail locations in Albuquerque, Sunland Park, and Las Cruces, plus three Oregon stores. doorhash differentiates through vertical integration (owns Don Verde Farms cultivation), delivery-first operations (Top Crop is retail-first), and a focused Las Cruces service area.
- **doorhash vs Mango Cannabis:** Mango Cannabis is a multi-state dispensary chain (Oklahoma, Michigan, New Mexico) positioned as a tropical-themed cannabis superstore. doorhash differentiates through craft-cultivation provenance from Don Verde Farms, modern app-grade delivery experience, and Las Cruces local roots.

## Brand information

- **Voice:** Plainspoken, confident, app-coded — closer to a modern food-delivery brand than a traditional dispensary.
- **Visual identity:** Black, white, leaf green (#8DC63F), and gold (#C9A961). The wordmark "doorhash" is always lowercase, one word.
- **Logo:** The doorhash wordmark features a stylized cannabis leaf integrated into the letter "d."

## Compliance

doorhash operates under New Mexico Regulation and Licensing Department (RLD) rules. All products are 21+ only. Cannabis products sold by doorhash are tested by accredited labs. Customers must present a valid ID at delivery. Daily and monthly purchase limits are enforced per New Mexico law.
